subject: sub02

candidate_budget.scope: Torch process intraop and current caller Numba thread mask

thread_configuration.limitation: Both active masks are 4; initial Numba pool capacity is 4 in baseline and 192 in candidate. OS thread totals and interop are not constrained to four.

precision.baseline_control: CUDA posterior scope: cuDNN TF32=False; matmul TF32=True; no autocast/half; CPU unchanged
precision.cpu_interpretation: CPU baseline posterior is unchanged and records no actual forward hooks; candidate two passes are observed float32/autocast-off. CUDA TF32 control flags do not change these CPU convolutions; do not claim direct actual-forward evidence for uninstrumented baseline.

wall_clocks_with_different_scope.baseline_scope: wrapper main entry through validation/import/context/entire old API and output/report writes; external monitor additionally includes interpreter startup and final stdout flush
wall_clocks_with_different_scope.candidate_scope: process creation through exit; includes interpreter/CLI startup, final JSON write and final stdout, unlike baseline wrapper-main clock
wall_clocks_with_different_scope.candidate_public_api_scope: includes validation/thread setup+restore; do not compare directly with legacy native_api_total_seconds

common_postvalidation_pipeline.scope: post-validation standard pipeline through output/mesh checks, before terminal internal report write; excludes initial imports/resource validation and public thread setup/restore

same_stage_sum.scope: sum of the same 66 stage rows; excludes between-stage report writes and initial validation; SynthSeg/brain_volume_stats per-stage IO boundaries differ
